column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/event_reset_more_values.onsa tests=11 evaluated=11 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ a part of events reset by a condition of sample: after the add when the event is above the call, before it when the event comes through ^ from below
render event_reset_more_values.ra_sample_above sr=0x41000000 in x=[3 1 4 2 5 1] c=[0 0 1 0 0 1]
render event_reset_more_values.ra_sample_below sr=0x41000000 in x=[3 1 4 2 5 1] c=[0 0 1 0 0 1]
@ a condition of sample / 4 is in the stage before the sample stage, one of block or a constant is at the call: the add comes first and the reset after it
process 0 params k=true frames=3 in x=[3 1 4]
process 0 params k=false frames=3 in x=[2 5 1]
@ a producer reset by an event: the reset is before its stage when the event is above, after it when its own event resets it, and a flow of events restarts at the event
render event_reset_more_values.pr_above sr=0x41000000 in x=[1 1 1 1 1 1 1] r=[0 0 3 0 0 0 7]
@ hit~(m, m).reset_if~(m > 3): the reset of the outside is once, before the two inputs tick one at a time
@ a delay of sample / 4 reset by an event of sample: the reset is after the tick of that frame, and the output the caller holds is not reset
@ the guard of && in a condition protects a division of block, for a flow and for a delay of events
process 0 params f=false k=0 frames=6 in x=[3 1 4 2 5 1]
process 1 params f=false k=0 frames=6 in x=[3 1 4 2 5 1]
process 2 params f=true k=20 frames=6 in x=[3 1 4 2 5 1]
process 3 params f=true k=20 frames=6 in x=[3 1 4 2 5 1]
process 4 params f=false k=0 frames=3 in x=[3 1 4]
process 4 params f=true k=20 frames=3 in x=[2 5 1]
process 5 params f=false k=0 frames=3 in x=[3 1 4]
process 5 params f=true k=20 frames=3 in x=[2 5 1]
@ a delay, sample_tick() and a parameter in a condition with an event: the condition is read at the tick of the event
process 0 params k=1 frames=3 in x=[3 1 4]
process 0 params k=2 frames=3 in x=[2 5 1]
process 1 params k=1 frames=3 in x=[3 1 4]
process 1 params k=2 frames=3 in x=[2 5 1]
@ the output of a delay of events that another source resets is the last tick's, in a named flow it is the default of the field
render event_reset_more_values.other_source sr=0x41000000 in v=[5 0 0 7 0 3 0 0] a=[0 0 0 0 1 0 0 0]
@ the reset of a delay of events goes back to the init that an input gives
render event_reset_more_values.with_start sr=0x41000000 cfg start=7 in x=[5 2 0 3 4 0]
render event_reset_more_values.with_start_delay sr=0x41000000 cfg start=7 in x=[5 2 0 3 4 0]
@ an event of a struct: a field in the condition resets before the tick, and the init of the delay is a struct
@ a block condition that turns true in a piece with no event does not reset a delay of events: it is read at the ticks
process 0 params k=false frames=3 in x=[0 4 0]
process 0 params k=true frames=3 in x=[0 0 0]
process 0 params k=false frames=2 in x=[6 0]
process 0 params k=true frames=1 in x=[7]
